text:
Type: large flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, kitchen
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: tight flat weave, space-dyed melange yarn, slim dark bound edge
Colors: grey-beige melange, light cream streaks, charcoal edge
Shape: large rectangle with fine horizontal streaked texture, thin flat profile, slim dark border, understated
Feel: calm, neutral, practical
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, light wood, white walls, black accents; Scandinavian or modern living and dining rooms

product.name: HODDE
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
